title: Resolution urging Albany to allow a city-owned public bank
summary: This resolution calls on the state legislature to pass, and the governor to sign, the “Bank of New York City Act” (A.11513), which would let cities of one million or more people create a municipal public bank. The bank would be barred from retail banking and public deposits, and would focus lending on affordable housing, worker cooperatives, renewable energy and underserved communities and businesses. It would be overseen by a nine-member board, a fifteen-member advisory board and subject to annual audits.
